snippet.title: Dino Crisis - Modern Edition | Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Dino Crisis - Modern Edition | Launch Trailer
It's out now!

🦖MOD PAGE: https://rotmill.itch.io/dino-crisis-modern-edition
Or here: https://github.com/Rotmill/Dino-Crisis-Modern-Edition

Modding Tool page (wip): https://github.com/Rotmill/Dino-Crisis-Studio

A fan mod for the original Dino Crisis (PS1). It brings a modern Resident evil Remakes like over-the-shoulder camera, updated controls, visual/gameplay improvements, and plenty of Quality of Life settings to customize the experience to your liking.

Requires your own copy of Dino Crisis for PS1 (disc image). No game files are included.
This is a non-commercial fan project.

#indiegame  #devlog  #gamedev
